environment.description: Node.js Express application deployed on EC2 instance in a public subnet. The /api/proxy endpoint is exposed without authentication. CRED_ROTATION_MS is set to default (3600000ms = 1 hour). The instance has an IAM role with S3 and DynamoDB access. No network egress filtering. Instance metadata service v1 (IMDSv1) is enabled. No WAF or reverse proxy in front of the application.

config.network: Public subnet, security group allows inbound 0.0.0.0/0:3000
